title: Pick standing desks for the office
ask: We're buying four standing desks for the new office. I've listed three models in sources/options.md. Tell me which to order in a short brief.
background: The desks need to take two monitors each, so I want a top at least 150 cm wide.
Kofi is 198 cm tall and needs the desk to go up to at least 125 cm.
The fit-out budget for desks is $2,400 all up.

constraints.text: don't put any dollar figure over $2,400 in the brief, and do show prices in dollars
compare the options in a table with the columns Model, Price each, Top height
show the sum as "Total for four: $..."
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
don't contact the desk suppliers or any other vendor
name the file you worked from, sources/options.md
give the warranty length of your pick

start.sources/options.md:
